meta.name: metropolis_hideout
meta.prompt: A high-tech apocalyptic hideout in the massively overgrown ruins of a metropolis.

programs.brief: A fortified sci-fi fusion power reactor and energy conduit pillar, glowing cyan energy conduits, heavy blast shielding, jury-rigged into the ruined concrete foundations.
An automated heavy defense sentry turret mounted on a reinforced steel tripod plinth with sensor array and ammo feeds.

tokens.fittings: blast_door on the fortified bunker_complex; airlock_vestibule on the hidden laboratory
tokens.infra: barricade_line across the shattered boulevard; perimeter_wire ringing the overgrown tower base
tokens.atmosphere: shattered skyscrapers engulfed by dense forest canopy, vine-wrapped concrete shells, concealed high-tech power conduits and fortified redoubt nestled in the metro ruins
